source.claimText: A compound of Formula (IA): [chem] or a salt thereof, wherein l is selected from 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5; m is selected from 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9; M1 is a bond or M'; M and M' are independently selected from -C(O)O-, -OC(O)-, -C(O)N(R')-, -P(O)(OR')O-, -S-S-, an aryl group, and a heteroaryl group; each R' is linear C1-18 alkyl; R4 is -(CH2)nQ, in which Q is OH or -OC(O)N(R)2, and n is selected from 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5; each R is independently selected from the group consisting of C1-3 alkyl, C2-3 alkenyl, and H; and R2 and R3 are independently selected from the group consisting of H, C1-14 alkyl, and C2-14 alkenyl.

core.note: Formula (IA). Upper arm N-CH2-CH2-(CH2)l-M1-R'; lower arm N-(CH2)m-M-CH(R2)(R3); R4 = -(CH2)nQ written as repeat n + group Q. The bracketed CH2 of each arm is the repeat unit as drawn.
